newsitem.title: SUDAN: Eleven people found dead in Sudanese desert.
newsitem.headline: Eleven people found dead in Sudanese desert.

text.p: Eleven people were found dead in the desert of northwestern Sudan after their bus got lost on its way to Libya, state television said.
Two people were discovered alive -- a driver's assistant and a man who apparently owned the bus. Four others were still missing, the television said on Saturday night.
A police spokesman said the bus left Dongola, the capital of Northern State, on August 29 on its way to Libya but never reached its destination.
Sudanese and Libyan officials launched a search for the bus. The television did not say when it was found.
The deserts of northern and northwestern Sudan, with few roads and street signs, have become a graveyard for travellers.
In May this year two people died between Abu Hamed and Atbara in northern Sudan. Nine people were found dead in June last year between Karima and Dongola.
